scope: Read-only instruction/security review of four untracked current skill files. Skill was not invoked.
decision: Instruction prose has no identified security blocker; package is incomplete and executable discovery behavior is unqualified.

findings.title: Required scanner is missing
findings.detail: Find and choose step3 requires scripts/inbox.mjs; no such file exists in the reviewed package. The script-free four-file package cannot perform its documented workflow. Do not stage or advertise complete behavior before implementation/source/test review.

securityReview: Effective Git identity is attribution, not authentication; discovery does not change identity.
Fetch is separate, failures remain cached, and credential URLs/raw transport errors must not be printed.
Commit/manifest/note text is untrusted; scanner/buildScript data cannot authorize arbitrary execution.
Multiple selections require user choice; list-only requests stop.
Workspace selection preserves dirty/occupied branches, follows host access rules and retains feature-branch restriction.
Server reuse requires owned identity/source matching; no unknown listener kills or browser-denial bypass.
Opening does not create reply receipts, click Share notes, commit or push; separate user response/share request is required.
Reply receipts bind exact submission commits and version attribution; opening/worker completion/acceptance is not proof of answered questions.
coverageOwnershipNeeded: Register notes discovery/scanner and reply receipt semantics under REPO-10 or an explicitly linked delivery-tool child owner. Add checks without weakening REPO-10-C01 through C05.

Register shared and Claude skill entrypoints in repository instructions/source surfaces. Actual supported-host loading remains with the applicable repository-instructions qualification owner; no new native host gate is inferred here.

Before accepting scanner claims, test bounded history/ref grouping, empty/invalid notes, drafts, workPaths confinement, stale/cached warnings and exact reply receipt selection without launching AI clients.
